checks.command:
out=$("${HERMES_MEMORY_REVIEW_PYTHON:-${THESYSTEM_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/workspace}/.agents/memory-review/bin/python}" "${THESYSTEM_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/workspace}/agents/skills/curate-memory/scripts/review_memory_requests.py" lifespan check --hermes-home "${HERMES_HOME:-$HOME/.hermes}" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || printf '%s' "$out" | grep -Eiq 'ERROR:|fail|error'; then printf 'FAIL standing-source comparison
'; exit 1; fi; if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -Eq '^STANDING (DRIFT|MISSING):'; then printf 'DRIFT standing communication source
'; exit 1; fi; printf 'OK standing-source comparison
'

safe_state.switch: hold the effective communication settings unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not replace or disable a communication block on drift; the tracked standing baseline is human-owned and drift is not actionable until the human confirms the intended source.

sampling.what: Daily comparison result for the canonical main personality and tracked standing communication entries; emit status only, never prompt text.
sampling.working_well: The check reports no missing or changed source, or reports drift for human review without exposing communication text.

open_decisions: USER.json standing entries are the tracked baseline; the human must confirm that this is the canonical owner-managed baseline before drift can be actionable.
